name: base-guarded-trader
description: An OpenAI Agents SDK agent on Base: the Sato Kit's tools run as function tools that stop for approval before anything that would sign, and every intent is quoted, prepared, simulated and checked by a policy pre-flight that explains every refusal. Fixture mode drives the SDK's runner with a scripted model and calls no model API. It signs only on a local fork with a throwaway key, or on Base Sepolia with a managed wallet.
